owner_direction.summary: The repository is public on GitHub. The three source files stay local and untracked, used only during the session that holds them. The repository records only SHA-256 hashes, byte sizes, titles and dates, non-sensitive line locators, control classifications, reconciliation results and minimal paraphrases needed to describe scope, gate and control requirements. No quotation or reproduction of correspondence, commercial strategy, journal material, credentials, keys or other sensitive content. The verifier checks the local files when present and fails closed when they are absent or their hashes differ.
owner_direction.effect_on_brief: Replaces the brief's committed byte-identical copy under tools/source-alignment/controlled-sources/ and its exact-quotation requirement. Locators are made reproducible by the SHA-256 of each cited line instead of a quotation.

delivery.extraction: Files extracted unchanged into project_sources/ at the repository root, which is excluded from git locally (.git/info/exclude) and is never committed.
